content: Sauri aratuuribhwa
Ribhaga riyo, Sauri aarɨ arangʼeha na amakango gaazɨ gu ukwita abhɨɨga bhʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu. Akaja kwa kuhaani ʉmʉkʉrʉ,

akamʉsabha amohe zɨnyarʉbha zu ukumwerekenʼya, ajɨ nazʉ mʉmarwazɨrʉ kʉrʉbhɨri rwa Damɨɨsikʉ, korereke areebhone abhahɨmba bhɨ ɨnzɨra ya Yɨɨsu, bhabhɨ abhasubhɨ hamwɨ abhakari, abhagwatɨ na kʉbhareeta Yɨrusarɨɨmu.
Neho Sauri akatanga orogendo rwazɨ rwu ukuja Damɨɨsikʉ. Hanʉ aarɨ ariisemera ʉrʉbhɨri ruyo, ubhwɨrʉ bhʉkabhanza kurwa mwisaarʉ, bhʉkamʉmʉrɨka mbaara zʉʉsi.
Akagwa haasɨ, akiigwa riraka rɨramʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Sauri! Sauri! Ndora ʉranyaacha?”
Sauri akabhuurya, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, awɨ nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ?” Akamʉgarukirya, “Inyɨ nɨ‑Yɨɨsu, wʉnʉ ʉkʉnyaacha.
Nawe imɨɨrɨra! Ujɨ usikɨrɨ mʉrʉbhɨri, muyo ʉrabhuurirwa ganʉ ukwenderwa okore.”
Abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhaarɨ na Sauri bhakiimɨɨrɨra na kukira kiri, bhakabha bhararʉgʉʉra, kʉ kʉbha ebho bhʉʉsi bhiigwirɨ riraka riyo, nawe bhatarʉʉzɨ mʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi.
Sauri akabhʉʉka kurwa haasɨ, nawe hanʉ aagɨmirɨ kʉramucha amɨɨsʉ, ataarʉʉzɨ kegero. Abhakɨndichazɨ bhayo bhakamugwata okobhoko na kʉmʉkangatya kuhika Damɨɨsikʉ.
Akiikara zisikʉ isatʉ mʉhʉku, ribhaga riyo ataariirɨ naabha kunywa chʉchʉsi.
Damɨɨsikʉ iyo, aareho umwɨga wʉmwɨ wa Yɨɨsu, iriina ryazɨ Ananiya. Ʉmʉkʉrʉ akamʉbhɨrɨkɨra Ananiya kʉbhʉrʉri. Akabhɨrɨkɨra, “Ananiya!” Ananiya akamʉgarukirya, “Inyɨ nɨrɨ hanʉ, Ʉmʉkʉrʉ.”

Ʉmʉkʉrʉ akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Bhʉʉka ujɨ kʉnzɨra yɨnʉ ikubhirikirwa Ɨngʉrʉrʉku, omohyɨ inyumba ya Yuuda hanʉ ɨrɨ. Ubhuuririryɨ muyo ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aruuriirɨ kʉrʉbhɨri rwa Tarisʉ, iriina ryazɨ Sauri. Nɨrakʉbhʉʉrɨrabhu kʉ kʉbha nangwɨnʉ Sauri arasabha Mungu,
wʉʉsi arʉʉzɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉmwɨ iriina ryazɨ Ananiya, arasikɨra na kʉmʉtʉʉrɨra amabhoko, korereke atʉrɨ korora naatu.”
Nawe Ananiya akamʉgarukirya, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, abhaatʉ bhaaru bhambuuriirɨ chɨmbu Sauri wuyo aabhakʉrɨɨrɨ amabhɨ abharɨndu bhaazʉ Yɨrusarɨɨmu!
Na nangʉ arɨ hanʉ, anʉ ʉbhʉnaja kurwa kʉbhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani, abhagwatɨ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakʉsabha kuriina ryazʉ.”
Nawe Ʉmʉkʉrʉ akamʉbhʉʉrɨra Ananiya, “Nuujɨ! Ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo nɨmʉrʉbhwɨrɨ abhɨ omohocha waanɨ, korereke araganʼyɨ iriina ryanɨ kʉbhaatʉ bhanʉ bhatarɨ Abhayaahudi, kʉbhatɨmi bhaabhʉ, na kuBhiiziraɨri.
Inyimwene nɨramwerecha chɨmbu araanyaakɨ bhʉkʉngʼu, igʉrʉ wi iriina ryanɨ.”

Ananiya akaja, akasikɨra munyumba yiyo, akamʉtʉʉrɨra amabhoko, akabhuga, “Umuhiiri waanɨ Sauri, Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu wʉnʉ aakuhwarukiirɨ kʉnzɨra, hanʉ waarɨ ʉraaza ɨnʉ, antumirɨ kwa naawɨ, korereke ʉtʉrɨ korora kwikɨ na wiizuribhwɨ Ekoro Ɨndɨndu.”
Hayohayo ebhegero ncha amagʉnzʉ bhɨkatorobhoka kurwa mʉmɨɨsʉ ga Sauri, akarora naatu, neho akiimɨɨrɨra, akabhatiizwa.
Akʉmara akarya ibhyakurya, akabhona amanaga. Sauri arahocha emeremo ja Yɨɨsu Damɨɨsikʉ Kuzisikʉ zendebhe, Sauri akiikara hamwɨmwɨ na abhɨɨga bha Yɨɨsu Damɨɨsikʉ iyo.
Hayohayo akatanga kuja mʉmarwazɨrʉ, akabha arabheerekeererya kʉbha, Yɨɨsu ni‑Mwana wa Mungu.

Abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhiitɨgɨɨrɨɨrɨ Sauri, bhakarʉgʉʉra bhʉkʉngʼu, bhakiibhuurya, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ tɨ newe aarɨ aranyaacha na kwita abhaatʉ bha Yɨɨsu Yɨrusarɨɨmu iyo? Ɨtarɨ kʉbha iizirɨ hanʉ abhagwatɨ korereke abhahirɨ kʉbhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani?”

Nawe Sauri akakaja kobhona ʉbhʉnaja na kʉbharuguurya Abhayaahudi bhanʉ bhaarɨ bhariikara Damɨɨsikʉ, kʉbhakandikija kʉ kʉbhabhʉʉrɨra Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu kʉbha, Yɨɨsu newe Kiriisitʉ, na bhataaturirɨ kʉmʉgarukirya.
Zisikʉ hɨru zɨkahɨta, Abhayaahudi bhakaseemya kumwita Sauri.
Nawe Sauri akabhuurirwa igʉrʉ we eseemyo yiyo. Abhayaahudi bhakabha bhararata mukisikʉ chʉ ʉrʉbhɨri ruyo ubhutikʉ nu umwise, korereke araahʉrʉkɨ bhamwitɨ.
Ubhutikʉ bhʉmwɨ, abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhakamogega bhakamʉtʉʉra murwero ʉrʉkʉrʉ na kumuhiringitya kʉhɨtɨra mwibhanga ryi inyiki yʉ ʉrʉbhɨri.
Sauri araja Yɨrusarɨɨmu

Neho Sauri akaja Yɨrusarɨɨmu. Hanʉ aahikirɨ iyo, akabha aragema kʉbha hamwɨmwɨ na abhɨɨga bha Yɨɨsu, nawe bhʉʉsi bhaarɨ bharamwʉbhaha, kʉ kʉbha bhataarɨ bhariisirirya kʉbha ewe wʉʉsi abhɨɨrɨ umwɨga wʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu.

Nawe Bharinaabha akamogega, akamuhira kʉbhatumwa bha Yɨɨsu. Akabhabhʉʉrɨra chɨmbu Sauri aarʉʉzɨ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ mʉnzɨra, chɨmbu Ʉmʉkʉrʉ aagambɨɨnɨ newe na chɨmbu Sauri aabhiijiryɨ abhaatʉ bhi iyo kuriina rya Yɨɨsu kwa bhʉkararu.
Mmbe Sauri wʉʉsi akabha hamwɨmwɨ nabhʉ Yɨrusarɨɨmu, aarɨ arabhiija abhaatʉ igʉrʉ wʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu kwa bhʉkararu.
Aarɨ aragamba na kʉhakaana na Abhayaahudi bhanʉ bhaarɨ bharagamba Ikigiriki, nawe bhayo bhakagema kumwita.
Hanʉ abhiisirirya abhandɨ bhaamɨnyirɨ ringʼana riyo, bhakamohereekerera bhakamuhicha kʉrʉbhɨri rwa Kaisaariya, bhakamʉtʉma ajɨ Tarisʉ.

Risengerero rɨkabha no omorembe mbaara zʉʉsi za Yudeya, Gariraaya, Samaariya na mbaara zʉʉsi bhakangʼeha kʉnaga na kʉhaabhwa zinguru ne Ekoro Ɨndɨndu. Abhiisirirya bhakabha bharamʉsʉʉka na kwitegeerera Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu, endengo yaabhʉ ɨkangʼeha kwaruha.
Ʉkʉhʉribhwa kwa Aineya
Hanʉ Peetero aarɨ ariiruguuraruguura mbaara zʉʉsi, korogendo rwazɨ, akahika kʉrʉbhɨri rwa Riida kʉbhataarɨra abharɨndu bha Mungu.
Kʉrʉbhɨri ruyo, akarumana nʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ, iriina ryazɨ Aineya, aarɨ akuurɨ ibhiimʉ, ahindiirɨ kʉbhʉrɨrɨ kwibhaga ryi imyaka ɨnaanɨ.
Peetero akamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Aineya, Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ arakohorya, bhʉʉka waarɨ ɨkɨragʉ chazʉ.” Hayohayo Aineya akiimɨɨrɨra!
Hanʉ abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhaarɨ bhariikara Riida na Sharʉʉni, bhaarʉʉzɨ Aineya aragenda, bhakiisirirya Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu.
Tabhiiza araryukurwa

Kʉrʉbhɨri rwa Yoopa, aarɨmu umwɨga wʉmwɨ wʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu, iriina ryazɨ Tabhiiza, kʉkɨgambʉ chi Ikigiriki, Dʉrikaasi, enzobhooro yaku ɨngabhi. Aarɨ arasakirya abhahabhɨ na kokora amangʼana amazʉmu kemerano.
Zisikʉ ziyo Tabhiiza akarwara, ɨtɨnɨrʉ akakwa. Abhaatʉ bhakooja ʉmʉbhɨrɨ gwazɨ, bhakamuhindirya ɨgatɨ mogorofa.

Kʉ kʉbha ʉrʉbhɨri rwabhʉ rwa Yoopa rwarɨ haguhɨ nʉ ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Ruuda, hanʉ abhɨɨga bhiigwirɨ kʉbha Peetero aarɨ Riida, bhakatʉma abhaatʉ bhabhɨrɨ kwa Peetero, kʉmʉsabha na kubhuga, “Nauzɨ ɨwɨɨtʉ nangwɨnʉ!”

Peetero akabhʉʉka, akahirana hamwɨmwɨ nabhʉ. Hanʉ bhaahikirɨ Yoopa, bhakamuhira ɨgatɨ igʉrʉ mogorofa. Abhakwirwa bhaaru bhakamwiruguura bhakabha haguhɨ neewe, bhararɨra na kumwerecha zɨshadi na zengebho ɨzɨndɨ zɨnʉ Dʉrikaasi aarɨ kubhatumɨra ribhaga ryʉ ʉbhʉhʉru bhwazɨ.
Peetero akabhahurucha abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi igʉtʉ, akahigama, akasabha Mungu. Akʉmara akeerekera ɨkɨtʉndʉ, akabhuga, “Tabhiiza imɨɨrɨra!” Tabhiiza akaramucha, hanʉ aamʉrʉʉzɨ Peetero, akagororoka akiikara.
Peetero akamugwata okobhoko, akamwimiirirya, akabhɨrɨkɨra abhakwirwa bharya na abharɨndu bha Mungu abhandɨ, akamʉtʉʉra mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwabhʉ, mʉhʉru.
Amangʼana gɨ ɨkɨsɨgʉ kiyo gakanyaragana bhʉkʉngʼu kʉrʉbhɨri rwʉsi rwa Yoopa, abhaatʉ bhaaru bhakiisirirya Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu.
Peetero akiikara sikʉ nzaru Yoopa kʉmʉkʉri wa amaseero, iriina ryazɨ Simʉʉni.

footnotes.text: Umwana wa Mungu. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora Ikiniibhasa.
